description: Unit tests for the SerialWorker class in the net/dns namespace, testing serial execution, retries, cancellation, and thread safety.

classes.name: SerialWorkerTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for testing SerialWorker behavior, including serial execution, retries, cancellation, and thread safety.

classes.name: SerialWorkerTest::TestSerialWorker
classes.description: Mock implementation of SerialWorker used for testing, with custom work item creation and finish handling.

classes.name: SerialWorkerTest::TestWorkItem
classes.description: Work item class that calls back into the test class to simulate work execution and follow-up.

methods.name: OnWork
methods.description: Simulates work execution, checks serial execution, updates output value, and signals completion.

methods.name: OnFollowup
methods.description: Handles follow-up work, possibly executing immediately based on test configuration.

methods.name: OnWorkFinished
methods.description: Checks if work succeeded, updates counters, and signals completion.

methods.name: BreakCallback
methods.description: Sets a breakpoint string and quits the run loop to synchronize test steps.

methods.name: BreakNow
methods.description: Posts a task to invoke BreakCallback with a specific string.

methods.name: RunUntilBreak
methods.description: Runs the message loop until a specific breakpoint string is encountered.

methods.name: CompleteFollowup
methods.description: Posts the follow-up closure to the task runner to simulate completion.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, including the task runner.

methods.name: TearDown
methods.description: Cleans up after tests, cancels worker, and ensures no stalled work remains.
